title: Ride-hailing app unreliable: login failures, driver no-shows, and unhelpful support
description: Users complain that the app is unreliable exactly when they need it most, with reports of being logged out at urgent moments and getting stuck in a relogin loop that never completes. Several reviewers say drivers fail to show up after long waits, do not answer calls, behave unprofessionally, and that customers are still charged cancellation fees in those situations. There are also widespread complaints about overcharging, surge fares that explode by the end of the trip, and the in-app help menu being a useless template-driven flow that ignores the actual question. People feel they cannot trust the service for time-sensitive trips like getting to the airport and that refund requests go unanswered.
affected_component: Ride booking, authentication, and customer support flow

title: Lock-screen ads and intrusive notifications hijack the device
description: Reviewers are upset that the app pushes ads and screensavers onto the lock screen, which they describe as hijacking the phone and even interfering with their alarm clock. People say they have to dismiss aggressive advertising before they can even unlock the device, and that video ads slow the phone down and consume memory. Many report that the notifications and lock-screen takeover persist even after disabling them in settings, leaving uninstall as the only workaround. The behavior is widely characterized as inappropriate and disrespectful of the user's device.
affected_component: Lock screen overlay and notification subsystem

title: Photo editor: gallery thumbnails missing and save flow broken after update
description: Since a recent update, users say they can no longer see their pictures in the gallery picker -- thumbnails appear as blank squares -- and they cannot save the photos they edit. Some report that selecting a portion of an image to copy no longer works and that an offline editing path that used to work has been removed. The save dialog has lost the option to choose a destination folder, and the add-photo step has become very slow. Several users have rolled back to older versions because the new release is unusable for their core editing workflow.
affected_component: Gallery picker and photo save/export pipeline

title: Cannot log in: account blocked, signup loop, and lost profile data
description: A large share of users say they simply cannot log into their account, often after switching to a new phone or reinstalling the app. The signup flow rejects their existing email and phone number as already in use but also refuses to log them in with the old credentials, leaving them stuck. Others report that logging in on a second device wipes their content settings and saved magazines/lists, forcing them to reconfigure everything from scratch. There is no working customer service path, so locked-out users have no way to recover their accounts.
affected_component: Authentication, account recovery, and cross-device sync

title: News reader: cluttered home screen, slow loads, and uncustomizable feed
description: Long-time users are frustrated that recent updates have piled extra UI onto the open screen and made article loading take twice as long as before. On tablets the on-screen keyboard covers the comment box, so users cannot read what they are typing in replies, and the app crashes frequently in normal use. Reviewers also complain there is no way to remove specific publishers like NYT from the feed or to expand beyond a hard limit of four topic pages, leaving them stuck with a feed they cannot tailor. Reports of objectionable articles are reportedly ignored even after the team asks for screenshots.
affected_component: News feed UI, article rendering, and personalization controls

title: Video editor: import errors, broken trim, and export failures
description: Users are reporting that the video editor frequently throws a 'file you chose may have been destroyed' error and refuses to import their own clips, even though the same files play fine elsewhere. The trim feature does not honor the requested start/end points, so clips begin or end in the wrong place, and after long edit sessions the export step silently fails partway through with the screen freezing on the progress dialog. Several users also complain that videos shared via WhatsApp are duplicated back into the gallery and fill up storage. A few even claim the app caused their phone to start malfunctioning after install.
affected_component: Video import, trim editor, and export/render pipeline

title: Edited photos lose clarity and look pixelated
description: A common complaint is that photos run through the editor come out pixelated, blurry, or noticeably lower quality than the source image, and reviewers say this has gotten progressively worse with each update. People note that the issue surfaces when they add a photo to a project or apply edits, and that imported images appear damaged on save. Many describe it as ruining their work, especially for users who rely on the app for school or professional projects. The expectation is that edits should preserve the original resolution and sharpness rather than degrade them.
affected_component: Image import/render pipeline and output quality

title: Magic Effects feature broken: 'something went wrong' and download failures
description: Users repeatedly report that tapping the Magic Effect button shows a 'something went wrong' message or a 'server busy' error and then dismisses, leaving them unable to use the feature at all. Several reviewers on devices like the Samsung A3 say the button is missing entirely or that the magic-effect download fails every time. The rest of the editor (e.g., FX) keeps working, so users feel singled out by a feature that is advertised but not functional for them. Reviewers want either a fix to the server/download path or clearer instructions on how to access the effects.
affected_component: Magic Effects feature and effect-pack download service

title: Notifications keep firing even after being disabled in settings
description: Users say push notifications -- cricket scores, promotional pings, and unrelated alerts -- continue to appear even after they have explicitly turned them off in the app's settings. Some report that toggles flip back on after an update, and that media auto-download keeps pulling images and videos despite the auto-download setting being unchecked. A new clear-notifications animation is described as pointless and annoying. The repeated interruptions and ignored preferences are pushing long-time users to uninstall.

title: Pre-installed app cannot be uninstalled and consumes excessive storage
description: An overwhelmingly negative cluster of reviews centers on users finding the app pre-installed (or auto-installed via a system update) on their device with no way to remove it. They say it occupies so much storage that they can no longer install other apps, and that it controls phone settings to prevent uninstall. People feel the app was forced onto their phone without consent and that the only mitigation -- disabling -- still leaves the storage and background activity in place. The dominant request is simple: let users uninstall it cleanly.
affected_component: App install/uninstall lifecycle and storage footprint

title: Antivirus app stops detecting threats and is itself flagged as malware
description: Users report that the antivirus they relied on has stopped responding and no longer detects viruses after a recent update, with the scanner either hanging or producing no results. Some claim the app itself is bundled with malware or causes software issues on their phones, citing damaged devices and lost paid subscriptions. Others say it gives constant false 'phone is infected' notifications and that removing it is hard because it keeps reinstalling itself. Trust in the product is collapsing because users feel their security tool is unreliable and possibly harmful.
affected_component: Antivirus scan engine and definition update service

title: App incompatible with newer Android versions and specific devices
description: A recurring complaint is that the app no longer works on newer Android releases (users mention Nougat 7.x and beyond), with reports of it stopping, crashing on launch, or refusing to start. Some users see a cryptic 'data directory has been set to read only' error after upgrading their OS and get no guidance on how to recover. Others mention specific device problems, for example the Mi Note, where the app behaves badly across multiple brand-new units. Reviewers expect the developer to ship updates that explicitly support current Android versions instead of leaving users stranded.
affected_component: Android OS compatibility and device-specific behavior

title: Purchased stickers, frames, and clip art lost or hidden after update/reinstall
description: Users who paid for sticker packs, frames, clip art, and backgrounds say their purchases disappear when they switch phones or after certain updates, forcing them to redownload assets repeatedly. In some cases the clip-art option has been removed entirely, breaking access to cutouts they had previously saved. People also note that even when assets are present they take a long time to load, and that the catalog feels limited unless they keep paying. They want their entitlements restored automatically and the previously available editing options brought back.

title: Latest update introduced regressions, broken UI, and slower performance
description: A large group of reviewers say the most recent update is significantly worse than the previous version, citing a worse user interface, missing news/content updates, and a marked drop in performance. Some report the app simply does not load anymore, hanging on its splash screen, while others say specific features they relied on no longer work after updating. The common theme is regression: the older version was better and the new one feels like trash. Users want either a fix that restores what used to work or a way to roll back.

title: UC Browser behaves like adware and shows security warnings
description: Users say UC Browser silently downloads and installs other apps without permission, and that even after they uninstall it, it reappears as soon as the phone connects to the internet. Several login flows on third-party sites warn the user that the browser has security problems, eroding trust. Long-time users report that browsing has become almost impossible in the last few weeks and that history is wiped after a short window, while video brightness controls have disappeared in fullscreen mode. The overall sentiment is that the browser has crossed from useful to invasive.
affected_component: Browser core, install/update behavior, and embedded ad SDK

title: App crashes on launch and during normal use, even after reinstall
description: Users report that the app crashes the moment they open it or after the first successful use, with one reviewer mentioning a hardware-acceleration error message before the crash. Reinstalling, clearing data, and following every troubleshooting step they can find does not help, and crash reports submitted from the device do not appear to lead to a fix. Some say a previous crash was patched but a new failure mode -- being unable to read content from the SD card -- has taken its place. The reliability problem is severe enough that users cannot get into the app at all on certain devices.

title: Connection errors persist on healthy Wi-Fi and mobile data
description: Reviewers say the app constantly throws 'connection failed' or 'cannot connect, sorry for the inconvenience' messages even though their Wi-Fi or mobile data is working fine for everything else. The problem is especially visible during availability checks (for example, ride or car-availability lookups) and when applying online effects. After a recent update, some features stopped working entirely without internet, with no clear indication of which actions need connectivity. Users want the app to either work offline where possible or correctly detect that the network is healthy.
affected_component: Network connectivity layer and server reachability checks

title: Frequent crashes interrupt core workflows
description: This cluster is dominated by short, exasperated complaints that the app crashes too often to be usable -- some users mention crashes happening at critical moments such as switching a gas bottle late at night when they need a hot shower in the morning. Reviewers describe the constant crashes as too annoying to bother with and say they cannot do anything in the app before it dies. A few note that an issue they reported was eventually fixed, suggesting the underlying crash is intermittent and version-dependent. The dominant ask is straightforward: make the app stop crashing.

title: Pages and sites fail to load or load extremely slowly
description: Users report that specific sites and the app itself simply will not open, or that the loading spinner persists indefinitely after install. Common targets like Facebook are described as taking far too long to load. Some users have just installed the app and find it unusable from the first launch, with content never appearing. Reviewers want the developer to investigate which sites or endpoints are failing and to address the underlying loading performance.

title: Downloads stall, fluctuate, or fail to complete
description: Reviewers report that downloads stop making progress, sometimes after reaching 30-40 MB and then bouncing backwards before stalling out. In other cases the download progress indicator is not shown at all, leaving the user with no idea whether anything is happening. Specific file types like .pkg are reported as undownloadable, and certain forced 'recommended downloads' silently fail. The expectation is that downloads either complete reliably or surface a clear, actionable error.

title: Junk-file cleaner reports inflated sizes and damages device behavior
description: Users complain that the junk cleaner exaggerates the amount of space that can be freed -- one reviewer says a 200 MB cache is reported as 450 MB -- and that running it has caused their phone to misbehave afterwards. After a recent update an 'exclusive clean' option disappeared on certain devices (notably Sony Xperia), so users cannot exclude paths they want to keep. Others find the app nags too frequently to clean and crosses into annoyance territory. The general feeling is that the tool is no longer trustworthy and may be doing more harm than good.

title: Music playback unreliable: songs won't play, stop mid-track, or desync from video
description: Users report that the player frequently refuses to play any song at all, requiring a full phone restart to play even one track, and that downloaded songs which used to work suddenly stop playing while others still do. Search results return loosely related artists instead of the requested track or person, making it hard to find the right song. On at least one device (Moto G3) the video stops while the audio keeps running, then resumes badly out of sync. Long-time users say the volume of bugs and glitches is pushing them toward Spotify and other alternatives.
affected_component: Audio playback engine and music search

title: App generally not functional -- 'doesn't work'
description: This cluster collects short, blunt complaints that the app simply does not work, refuses to work, or is no longer functional 'as it should be.' Reviewers do not provide much detail, but the consistency of the language suggests a complete failure mode rather than a partial regression -- people install or open the app and nothing happens. The dominant rating is 1 star and there is no indication of a successful path through the core feature. The developer needs to investigate what 'doesn't work' means for the affected installs (possibly launch failure, blank screens, or feature-level no-ops).

title: Star-rating prompt nags repeatedly and crashes lose user work
description: Users report that the app keeps showing rate-the-app prompts even after they have already submitted a rating, and that the nag screen continues to appear daily for over a year. On top of that, the app crashes mid-edit and discards work -- one reviewer describes losing hours of detailed editing in a single crash. Some users would have given the app a higher rating but cannot because of long-standing login issues that have been reported for years without resolution. The combination of pushy rating prompts, lost work, and unresolved bugs drives the score down.
affected_component: Rating prompt frequency control and editor stability

title: App appears unwanted and cannot be uninstalled
description: Reviewers say the app showed up on their device without their knowledge -- they don't recall installing it -- and that the uninstall option is either missing or fails. Many describe it as completely irrelevant to their use of the phone yet impossible to remove, and warn other users to 'avoid it like the plague.' A few note that they would keep it but resent that they have no choice in the matter. The fundamental complaint is loss of control: the user wants the app gone and the system will not let them remove it.

title: Messages and calls not delivered in real time; online status broken
description: Users report that messages they send do not get delivered and that they only see incoming messages and calls when the app is opened in the foreground -- there is no real-time push, so they have to manually open the app to discover communication attempts. The 'connecting...' state is described as continuous, with no message exchange possible during it. After recent updates, some users say outbound calls have stopped working entirely and only text messages go through. Online status is reported as inaccurate, showing users online while the app is closed. Support replies in the wrong language compound the frustration.
affected_component: Messaging delivery, push pipeline, and presence/online status

title: Launcher: settings not applied, wrong icons, and lost app names
description: Users of the launcher complain that its settings panel does not always apply changes, that the app drawer is disorganized with no easy way to arrange apps, and that after a phone reboot the system takes far too long to restore the launcher even when 'set as default' has been chosen. Some report that app names disappear under icons with no toggle to bring them back. The wrong icon images are also being shown for apps that have multiple variants. The result is a launcher that feels almost-good but breaks several core expectations users have for a home-screen replacement.
affected_component: Launcher home screen, app drawer, and icon rendering

title: App makes phone slow and laggy after install or update
description: Users report that installing the app -- or updating it to the newest version -- causes their phone to become noticeably sluggish, with general lag across the system rather than just inside the app. Several mention that things were fine on the older version and only degraded after the update. The slowness is described as severe enough to make them want to uninstall, with reviewers asking the developer to optimize the app for lower-end devices. The expectation is simple: installing the app should not regress overall device performance.
affected_component: Background services and overall device performance impact

title: Generic bug-fix asks: 'just fix it' and lingering technical issues
description: This cluster gathers short, generic feedback like 'fix bug please,' 'some technical problem,' and 'they fixed most things, better late than never.' Users acknowledge that previous bugs have been addressed but flag that work is still pending and that some operations take much longer than they should. There is no single concrete failure described; instead, the cluster represents a steady drip of low-detail bug reports asking the team to keep iterating on stability. The signal here is more about ongoing quality than any single defect.

title: App stopped working after recent update; conflicting update prompts
description: Users say the app has stopped working since a recent update and want a patch. A specific frustration is that the in-app prompt insists an update is required, while the Play Store reports the app is already up to date, leaving users unsure whether the prompt is a real notice or just an ad. Suggested troubleshooting steps from support reportedly do not resolve the problem. A few users note that after a follow-up fix they no longer see the failure, indicating intermittent regressions tied to releases. Reviewers want the update channel to be reliable and consistent with the Play Store.
affected_component: App update flow and post-update functionality

title: Better trip-planning UI, fare estimate, and in-trip issue reporting
description: Users want a clearer trip-planning interface and account-management screens, complaining that current flows for planning trips, deleting credit cards, and editing names feel like 'rubbish.' A frequently requested feature is a pre-trip fare estimate so riders know how much to expect to pay before booking, which reviewers say used to exist and was removed. People also want a way to raise a concern about a driver while a trip is in progress, not just after the fact, and request refund handling when a driver cancels with a charge. Map accuracy concerns (such as missing speed-zone information) round out the feature asks.
affected_component: Trip planning UI, fare estimation, in-trip support, and map data

title: Reduce ad density and stop full-screen / lock-screen ad takeovers
description: Reviewers want fewer ads and, in particular, the elimination of full-screen ads that interrupt their workflow. Several complain that the app changes their lockscreen by itself to display ads, and that intrusive features are turned on by default rather than opt-in. Users acknowledge that some advertising is needed but ask the developer not to be greedy with formats that cover the whole screen or follow them outside the app. The request is essentially to right-size monetization so ads do not feel hostile to the user.

title: More video-editing controls: subtitles, scrub buttons, and audio handling
description: Users are asking for richer video-editor controls: fast-forward and rewind buttons in the video player, next/previous track navigation, and the ability to attach a subtitle file to a video. Several reviewers want to remove the original audio track from a clip and replace it with their own music, and to extend the duration of photos in a slideshow to match the length of an audio track. There are also asks around longer video duration limits (so a clip is not silently shortened from over a minute down to thirty seconds). These are largely additive feature requests rather than complaints about broken behavior.
affected_component: Video player controls and editor timeline

title: Customizable news feed: source filtering, fewer clickbait articles
description: Readers want better control over the news feed -- specifically the ability to filter or block individual sources, hide clickbait, and reduce articles from unaccredited publishers. Several reviewers describe the post-redesign interface as cluttered and gunky and say they would like the older, cleaner experience back. They also request more diversity in sports coverage (for example, rugby league and baseball alongside soccer) rather than a hard-coded set of topics. The underlying ask is for personalization controls that match the breadth of content available.
affected_component: News feed personalization and source management

title: General improvements requested: simpler UX, more options, less invasiveness
description: This cluster is mostly broad 'could be better' feedback. Users say the app has become more complicated than it needs to be and want it simplified back toward the earlier, cleaner experience. Some ask for more configuration options and tougher problem coverage in the feature set, while others say the app has become invasive enough that they are switching to alternatives. Ratings are mixed (large 3-star presence), suggesting the experience is acceptable but stagnant. The developer should treat this as a signal to invest in usability and option depth rather than a single concrete defect.

title: Preserve original photo resolution and offer HD save options
description: Users editing photos report that the saved output has both smaller dimensions and lower quality than the source image -- one reviewer says edited files dropped from a multi-megabyte original down to 'digit or digit kilobyte.' They want the app to preserve the original quality through the edit pipeline and to offer an HD save option (for example, increasing the maximum image size to higher megapixel values). Long-time users feel that quality has degraded across recent updates and want a setting to keep the previous behavior. This is more a quality-preservation request than a bug, hence its mixed but generally favorable rating mix.

title: Clean up shortcut/booster bloat and let users disable bundled features
description: Reviewers want the developer to remove or sandbox the 'crazy shortcut' booster that kills other apps, and to clean up sponsored links and what users perceive as malware-laced suggestions. Many feel the app was fine until extra add-ons were bundled in. Samsung users in particular complain that the app is pre-installed and that it can be deleted by anyone with phone access (no password protection on uninstall). The request is to let users disable or uninstall the bundled features and to stop including third-party junk in the default experience.
affected_component: Bundled features (shortcut booster, link recommendations) and uninstall protection

title: More fonts, text effects, and dark/night theme options
description: Users want a richer text-on-photo experience: more font styles, free effect/filter/theme additions in each update, typographic portrait support, and meme-friendly fonts that look more polished. Several reviewers also ask for an option to increase text size and a dark/night theme skin, noting that the current text rendering feels too small and the UI lacks a low-light mode. A few request a self-read (text-to-speech) capability. These are mostly enhancement asks; ratings are predominantly positive with a long tail of 'add this feature' comments.

title: More stickers, frames, and clip-art with clearer purchase status
description: Reviewers ask for an expanded catalog of stickers, frames, magic effects, and clip art, ideally bundled into a single download and at lower prices. They want clearer signals about which items are free versus paid and a fix for cases where purchased frames or clip art do not appear in the user's library. Some ask for the ability to upload their own images and use them as animated stickers. Overall the rating distribution is positive, indicating these are growth-oriented requests rather than complaints about something broken.

title: Bring back the older version: feature richness and sharpness regressions
description: Many users explicitly prefer a previous release of the app, saying the latest update lost options and visibly reduced sharpness in the editor's output. The dominant request is either to ship a revert or to surface the missing options in the new UI. Users feel that updates have removed features rather than adding to them, and that the trade-off is not worth it. A subset wants a way to install or pin the older version themselves until parity is restored.
affected_component: Versioning, feature parity with previous release, and image sharpness

title: Support more languages and custom fonts (Indonesian, Hindi, Latin, Urdu)
description: Non-English users are asking for broader language support across the app's text and editing tools. Specific requests include Indonesian for general UI, Hindi fonts, Latin script, and the ability to load custom fonts from the SD card -- a capability some users say was removed in a recent update. Several reviewers note that the app is bundled on Indian-market Samsung devices yet does not address Indian users adequately. Adding more languages and restoring the personal-font option would meaningfully expand the audience.

title: Better AppLock controls: real password lockscreen and broader app coverage
description: Users want AppLock to support a real lockscreen that requires a password to unlock the device, not just per-app locks, and to let them protect any app on the system rather than a fixed launcher subset. Several reviewers report that the passcode silently changes when they choose 'forgot passcode,' which they feel undermines the whole point of a lock. There are also complaints about the app pop-up behavior trying to unlock itself in the background and adding ads at left and right of the screen. The asks are mostly enhancements (full lockscreen, more apps, no-touch mode) plus polish to the existing unlock flow.
affected_component: AppLock feature, lockscreen integration, and password recovery

title: Background editing tools: change colors, auto-cut, and chat backgrounds
description: Users want better tools for working with image backgrounds: a way to change the background color of a photo (including changing hair color), an automatic background-removal feature to attract more users to the editor, and an eraser specifically for text. They also ask for the ability to change the chat background in messaging contexts instead of being forced into a default 'children's background.' A handful of users have repeatedly requested these for months and feel ignored. Ratings skew very positive, indicating these are wishlist enhancements rather than blocking issues.
affected_component: Background editing tools and chat theming

title: General photo-editing positivity with one regression: cannot add photos
description: Most reviewers in this cluster are happy with the photo editor, calling it one of the best on the market and recommending it over alternatives like Photo Grid. The standout feature request is a way to add photos during an active edit session -- one user complains that this no longer works. A few comparison-driven reviewers ask for parity with desktop editors that have more layered features. Overall the cluster is dominated by 4-5 star ratings and reads more like 'keep adding features' than 'fix something broken.'

title: Save-to-gallery without forced share, plus messenger sharing
description: Users want a clean 'save to gallery / phone' option that does not force them to share the photo to a social network first. Several reviewers describe being kicked out of the editor mid-edit because the save flow funnels them into a profile share, and then the partial edit is lost. People also ask for a share-to-messenger target, which is currently missing, and complain about a separate concern: the app installing additional spam-like apps without consent. The core ask is to decouple 'save' from 'share' and give users a phone-only save path like the older version had.
affected_component: Save/share flow in the editor and gallery export

title: Unlock more effects and reduce paid-only gating to earn 5 stars
description: A common pattern in this cluster is users explicitly tying their star rating to specific feature additions: brightness controller, notification toolbar editor, screenshot tool, antivirus, more customization options, and parity with effect packs from competitor apps such as Snow or B612. Reviewers say they would happily give 5 stars if more effects and tools were free rather than locked behind in-app purchases, and ask the team to stop nagging them to rate the app. Some also dislike a full-control prompt screen that pops up and want it to be optional. Overall this is a feature-request cluster with mixed but mostly mid-range ratings.
affected_component: Feature gating, in-app purchase model, and rating prompt

title: Add more camera filters and restore older filter look
description: Users want a wider variety of camera filters and effects, citing competitor apps like Candy Camera as having more attractive options (e.g., 'kiss me'). Several reviewers say that the recent filter update made photos look more 'edited' and artificial than before, and they prefer the older filter aesthetic. There is also a small ask to allow username changes, but the dominant theme is filter quality and quantity. Ratings are largely positive, so this is a growth/polish request rather than a bug.
affected_component: Camera filter library and filter rendering style

title: Better in-app help, tablet support, and clearer free-vs-paid limits
description: Reviewers ask whether the messaging features work on tablets and request explicit tablet support. They also want better in-app help and clearer guidance on what the rating numbers and content counts mean -- one user complains that the badge says there are several items but the list shows 'no items' when tapped. Several note that useful content is gated behind paywalls after a small free allowance and want either more free articles or a clearer paywall UX. There is also general dissatisfaction with the UI and a desire for more effects and improvements. Mixed ratings drive a P2 priority.
affected_component: In-app help, tablet support, and free-tier UX

title: Brighter flashlight, screen-off mode, and use while in other apps
description: Flashlight users want a few specific enhancements: the ability to keep the flashlight on while using another app, a screen-off mode so the display does not stay lit while the torch is in use, and a setting to force full brightness on devices where auto-brightness fails. Some compare the brightness unfavorably to the iPhone's stock flashlight and ask for a brighter output. There is also nostalgia for a previous 'light mode' that reviewers preferred. The cluster is a mix of polish requests rather than a single broken feature.
affected_component: Flashlight controls, brightness settings, and background operation

title: More editing features, free access, and built-in tutorial
description: Users like the editor overall but say it would be even better with a few additions: a center alignment/composition tool similar to Phonto, free access to more advanced features that are currently paywalled, and an in-app tutorial that walks new users through editing workflows. A few reviewers report that editing crashes and lags too often, which they want addressed alongside the new features. One Spanish-language reviewer asks for the option to enable or disable specific functions independently. Ratings skew positive, so this is mostly a wishlist cluster.
affected_component: Editor feature set, paywall, and onboarding/tutorial

title: Users want a clean UC Browser without bundled UC News and ad notifications
description: A large group of users are complaining that UC Browser has effectively turned into a news/ads platform rather than a browser. They want a clear in-app option to turn off UC News on the homepage and to stop the constant push notifications about clickbait headlines, sports stories, and promoted content. Several reviewers also call out that the small-window mode that existed in older versions has disappeared and ask for it back, and others request a built-in reading mode for long-form articles. The overall sentiment is that the app feels bloated and that they would happily uninstall unless the news, ads, and notifications can be disabled.
affected_component: UC Browser homepage / UC News integration / notification settings

title: Photo editor users want richer blur tools (auto blur, shape blur, defocus)
description: Users editing photos in the app are asking for an expanded set of blur capabilities. They specifically want an automatic background blur or portrait-style defocus, additional blur shapes such as circle/radial blur, and a free-hand blur brush so they can selectively blur parts of an image. Several reviewers say the current blur tab is too limited compared to competitor editors and that they would rate the app higher if these were added. Sentiment is mostly positive (4-5 stars dominate) so this is feature polish on an otherwise loved tool.

title: No way to disable or reduce intrusive in-app notifications and popups
description: Users are frustrated that there is no setting to turn off the constant notifications, popups, and reminders the app pushes (clean reminders, optimization nudges, update banners, etc.). Reviewers point out the irony that a notification cleaner app itself spams notifications, and they want a single switch to silence them or to opt out per category. Many say they end up uninstalling because the popups interrupt other apps and clutter the status bar. Rating skews to 1 and 3 stars, indicating broad annoyance rather than a hard crash.

title: PDF/document app missing in-document search, bookmarks, and tabs
description: Users are asking for stronger search and navigation features in the document/PDF reader. The biggest request is in-PDF text search so they can find a word inside an open document, plus a web search option when long-pressing a word. Reviewers also want bookmarks to jump back to annotations, tabs to switch between open PDFs, and a library/shelf view so imported documents do not need to be re-browsed each time. A few complain about an unwanted Yahoo search bar appearing in the search area. Sentiment is mixed but skewed negative.

title: Users want stronger antivirus features: scheduled scans, pre-install checks, detail reports
description: Reviewers want the security/cleaner app to actually behave like a real antivirus. Specific requests include automatic background scans on a schedule, a pre-install scan that runs before any new app is downloaded, detailed reports of what was scanned and found, and a unified suite that bundles all of the vendor's security products. Several complaints state the current detection is unreliable and feels more like a junk cleaner than a true AV. Ratings are spread across all stars with a 1-star plurality, reflecting a trust gap.

title: Drawing module missing paint bucket, more brushes, and layers
description: Users of the drawing tool are asking for a paint bucket / fill tool so they can flat-fill an area with one tap instead of brushing it in. They also want a wider brush library (more textures and styles), grid/measure guides for structured drawing, and layer functionality, with several noting that layers seem to have disappeared in a recent update. The cluster skews toward 4-5 star reviews, so this is enhancement-level polish on a feature people already enjoy.

title: Magic Effects feature missing or not visible after update
description: Many users report that after updating the app the Magic Effects entry is no longer showing up next to the tools menu, and they cannot figure out how to access it. They are asking for either a tutorial video on how to add magic effects or a fix that restores the button. A subset also says the magic button is extremely slow when it does appear. Ratings are mixed but lean positive, suggesting users like the feature and just want it back/working.

title: Generic requests for additional app features and broader device support
description: This is a grab-bag of feature requests where users are asking for assorted enhancements: extra built-in widgets/options found on rival apps, support for motorcycle riders, an expanded list view, and various small UI tweaks. The common thread is users feel the app is close to ideal but want one or two specific additions before they would rate it higher. Sentiment is mostly neutral with a 3-star plurality.

title: Account login broken: no password reset, forced registration, can't recover account
description: Users are blocked from accessing their accounts because the password reset flow is broken or missing. Several say they were never asked for an email at signup, yet the reset screen demands one, leaving them locked out permanently. Others complain the app now forces mandatory registration to use any feature, and that there is no clear way to recover an account if they forget their username or password. Many also ask for e-signature verification through the mobile app similar to the desktop version. Rating distribution is heavily 1-star and the workflow blocks core use.

title: Watermark on edited photos: users want it removed or customizable
description: A large share of reviewers are complaining about an automatically applied watermark on saved or shared images. Many say it ruins the photo and want a free option to remove it, while others would accept it if they could replace it with their own custom logo or name as a personal watermark. Some specifically call out that the square-fit edits started watermarking after a previous update. Ratings are spread fairly evenly which makes this feel more like a top annoyance than a hard blocker.

title: Photo quality degrades after editing or saving
description: Users are complaining that photos come out lower quality than the source after being edited or saved through the app. Colors look fine in the preview but shift once the picture is captured/saved, and saved images appear blurry or downscaled (with several mentioning a 480p cap on the unpaid version). Cropping is also reported as imprecise. The app also slows or stops when handling large photos. With over half the ratings at 1-2 stars, this is a meaningful regression on a core editing flow.

title: App overrun by ads, draining battery and making it unusable
description: Reviewers say the app is now stuffed with ads to the point that it is barely functional, especially on cellular data where the constant ad-loading freezes interactions. Users mention popup ads, video ads, ads on the home screen, and fake disable-ad buttons that switch ads back on. Beyond the annoyance, users say the ad traffic and ad rendering aggressively drain battery and slow the device. Sentiment is heavily negative with about 80% of ratings at 1-2 stars.

title: App drains battery aggressively, even more than apps it claims to optimize
description: Users report that this app, which markets itself as a battery saver/optimizer, is itself one of the heaviest battery drains on their phones. They observe the battery percentage falling rapidly while the saver is running, and several say uninstalling it noticeably improved battery life. Some also note constant background restarts and CPU usage. With more than half the ratings at 1-2 stars, this is a significant trust and performance issue on the app's core promise.

title: App slows down the entire phone, especially while charging or browsing
description: Users report that installing this app makes their phone noticeably sluggish across the system, not just inside the app itself. Several say the device becomes nearly impossible to unlock while charging, browser sessions are cut off, and on tablets the screen has frozen. A few also describe the app behaving like malware. Ratings are heavily 1-star and people frequently uninstall to recover device performance.

title: Ride-hail app: GPS and map send drivers wrong way and assign far-away cars
description: Riders complain that the app's GPS and mapping are unreliable, frequently signaling 'GPS signal lost' and showing drivers in wrong locations. They are matched with drivers who are far from the pickup point even when closer cars exist, drivers then get lost and the rider has to call to give directions, and trips arrive late or get cancelled. App speed itself is slow even on good connections. With ~80% of ratings at 1-2 stars and core mobility broken, the impact is severe.

title: Launcher app drains battery faster than any other app, even with battery saver on
description: Users running this launcher report severe battery drain since the latest update, with several noting it has become the single biggest battery consumer on their device. The drain continues even when the built-in battery saver is active, the app frequently restarts in the background, and customer support has reportedly not responded to complaints. Even paying users say they are uninstalling because their phones won't last the day. Rating distribution is dominated by 1-stars.

title: App is consistently slow
description: A large number of short reviews simply say the app is slow, often very slow, and sometimes too slow to be usable. Users want speed improvements without specifying a particular flow, suggesting overall responsiveness has degraded. A few mention the app is also expensive given its sluggishness. Ratings split between 1, 2, and 3 stars with 1-star being the largest bucket.

title: App consumes excessive storage and background data
description: Users complain that the app takes up far more space than competing apps and silently consumes large amounts of background data, with one reviewer reporting 7GB used in a month even after disabling features. The 'junk cleaner' functionality is also accused of falsely reporting cleaned space and even deleting user photos. Some users on devices with plenty of free storage are still told they are out of space by the app. Heavily 1-star skewed.

title: Downloads are very slow, sometimes failing on locked screen
description: Users report that downloads through the app are far slower than they should be, with some saying speed drops to ~2KB/s the moment the phone is locked. The app also reportedly cannot open certain torrent sites and uses excessive RAM during downloads. Ad blockers built in to the app are not working properly either. Sentiment is split but skews to 1-star, indicating downloads, the core function, are broken or unreliable for many.

title: Cooler/optimizer app overheats device and drains battery instead of helping
description: Users report that the cooler/optimizer app, which is supposed to manage CPU temperature and battery, is doing the opposite: phones overheat after installing it, even when the app is granted all permissions, and the device gets sluggish from the app running in the background. Battery drain accelerates and several users say uninstalling restored normal thermal and battery behavior. About 78% of ratings are 1-2 stars.

title: App is very slow to open and load content
description: Users complain that the app takes a very long time to open and that content (e.g. collage grids, cached items) loads extremely slowly compared to older versions. Some say it is so slow they get bored waiting and will switch to another app. Ratings are split, with the largest single bucket being 1-star, indicating load latency is a real pain point but not yet a hard crash.

title: Antivirus app accused of being adware that slows phone instead of finding viruses
description: Users say the antivirus product is essentially adware: it pops up fake virus warnings, demands the user install or keep additional apps to 'remove' viruses, fails to actually delete threats, and floods the device with ads and bloatware that drain RAM and battery. Several note that the app drives device performance into the ground and does not behave like a legitimate AV product. Rating is overwhelmingly 1-star.

title: App causes the phone to hang frequently
description: Users complain that installing this app causes their phones to hang or freeze regularly, including on devices with adequate RAM. Several note that the hangs are tied to ad rendering or to the app self-restarting in the middle of editing. Some report they would have rated higher if not for the constant hangs. Largely 1-star sentiment confirms this is a stability problem rather than a minor slowdown.

title: App became slow and unstable after recent updates, especially on flagship devices
description: Long-time users say the app's responsiveness has clearly degraded over the past several updates, with frequent lag, slow camera launch, slow tab switching, and progress bars sitting on screen. Specific cases mention an HTC Desire and Note device where the app no longer returns to the screen during navigation, breaking hands-free driving use. Even on flagship phones the experience is described as 'wire'/unstable. Heavily 1-star skewed.

title: Battery saver app actually drains battery dramatically over a few hours
description: Users say that the very app that promises to save or boost battery life is in fact eating their battery. Concrete examples include phones dropping from 100% to very low percentages within a few hours, the saver itself listed as the top battery consumer in system stats, and the device losing 30-40% overnight after install. Many also mention auto-data-saver settings being reset every time. With 71% of ratings at 1-star, this is a severe contradiction of the app's value proposition.

title: App is laggy, especially while browsing files or refreshing
description: Users report general laginess across the app, with specific mentions of file browsing and screen refresh being delayed. A few link the lag to other side effects like virus warnings or things getting worse over time. Rating split is roughly half 1-2 star and a meaningful 3-star bucket, so this reads as a chronic UX drag rather than a hard break.

title: New version is slower and uses more RAM than older versions; users want rollback
description: Users say the latest version has regressed in performance: it loads more slowly, consumes more RAM, hangs the phone, and makes online players or other features feel worse than they used to. Many explicitly ask to bring back the old version or say they will uninstall and switch to a previous APK. About two-thirds of ratings are 1-2 stars, signaling a clear regression after update.

title: Cleaner app spams unstoppable notifications and drains battery and CPU
description: Users say the cleaner/optimizer app pushes a constant stream of notifications about news, sports gossip, updates, and 'clean now' reminders that cannot be turned off through the in-app settings, often requiring force-stop at the system level. The persistent quick-access notification cannot be removed from the status bar, the app runs constantly in the background, and many tie its presence to noticeably worse battery life and CPU consumption. Heavily 1-star.

title: App freezes and locks up the phone, sometimes preventing shutdown
description: Users report that the app frequently freezes and takes the rest of the phone with it, including locking up the screen, blocking shutdown, and making the device hard to unlock. Specific cases mention the app freezing after Wi-Fi disconnect and staying frozen for hours, plus repeated lockups on Samsung Galaxy and Pixel devices. The freezes are often blamed for forced uninstalls. About 75% of ratings are 1-2 star.

title: Very slow loading and sluggish server responses
description: Users repeatedly complain that the app is slow to load content and feels server-bound, with many short reviews simply asking the developer to make it faster. A few mention that download speed within the app is also poor. Ratings skew negative but with a sizable 3-star bucket, suggesting frustration without complete breakage.

title: News app full of clickbait, unwanted notifications, and reduced topic options
description: Long-time users say the news app has gone downhill, replacing real journalism with gossip columns and clickbait, and that the new version offers far fewer source/topic choices than the older Galaxy edition. Push notifications are aggressive and sometimes contain spammy virus warnings, and several users say they cannot get rid of the app even after uninstalling because it keeps coming back. Ratings are bimodal (many 1-stars but also 5-stars from people who like the digest), with negative sentiment leading.
affected_component: News content quality / notifications / source selection

title: Constant ads, forced sign-in, and degraded UI ruining the experience
description: Users say the interface has changed for the worse, with intrusive popup ads everywhere, forced account sign-in even for users who do not want one, and ads still appearing for those who paid for ad-free subscriptions. Several ask the developer to stop pushing additional apps and games every time they open the product, and many say they are looking for a replacement. About 72% of ratings are 1-2 stars.

title: Ride-hail app: fare miscalculation, surge pricing, payment issues, rude drivers
description: Riders complain about a tangle of usability and trust issues with the ride-hail app: cash payment options that they feel endanger drivers and passengers, opaque and constantly changing surge prices, fares calculated using longer routes than necessary, drivers starting the meter miles away from the actual pickup, and unhelpful customer support that responds with templated replies. Several also report not being able to enter payment details to set up an account at all. With 87% of ratings at 1-2 stars, this reflects deep dissatisfaction with core booking and billing flows.

title: Too many ads making the app feel like spam
description: Most reviews in this group are short complaints that the app simply has too many ads, sometimes describing it as basically spam. A few users ask whether there is any way to disable or ignore ads. The negative volume is high but mixed with a meaningful 3-star bucket, indicating widespread annoyance rather than a hard functional break.

title: Antivirus/cleaner app: mostly liked, but accused by some of installing spyware and clutter
description: Most users say the antivirus/cleaner app does its job, detects viruses easily and makes their phones run smoother, but a vocal minority claim it installed spyware or extra clutter on their devices and that they saw no real performance improvement. Some on low-RAM phones do report it works smoothly. Ratings are broadly positive (about 56% at 4-5 stars), so this is more a polish and trust issue than a blocker.

title: Photo editor praised as easy and fun, with rare quality complaints handled well by support
description: Reviewers describe the photo editor as one of the easiest and most fun editing apps they have used, with strong support for stickers, text, and a wide variety of edits. A handful of users had quality issues when overlapping images and praised the support team for fast, helpful responses. About 80% of ratings are 4-5 stars, so this is a satisfaction-level cluster with only minor polish opportunities.

title: Navigation app: offline maps unreliable, expensive premium features, license errors abroad
description: Users say the navigation app works well when online but breaks down when offline, with frequent 'no licence' errors and lost positioning when crossing into low-data regions. Some report poor instruction quality on highways (no exit signs, unclear streets) compared to competitors, and many basic-feeling features being locked behind premium. Others praise the offline capability and memory-friendliness when it works. Ratings are evenly split with a 1-star plurality.

title: Interface broadly praised as clean and easy to use
description: Most users describe the app's interface as clean, fast, and easy to operate, with comments calling it convenient, well-organized, and great for protection or organization tasks. A small number of reviewers say it is not user-friendly enough. With ~77% of ratings at 4-5 stars, this is a positive cluster reflecting general satisfaction with the UI.

title: Adware overlay hijacks the phone lock screen without permission
description: Users say a recent update silently installed an ad overlay on the device's lock screen, disguised as a 'smart charging' or quick-charge feature. They describe it as deceptive, as the source of the new lock-screen ads is not initially clear and the option to disable it is buried. Some specifically point out that inappropriate images can appear where children might see them. Long-time users are uninstalling after years of use, and ~80% of ratings are 1-2 stars.

title: Intrusive popup ads, including manipulative 'rate 5 stars' prompts
description: Users say their previously good experience has been ruined by an explosion of popup ads after recent updates, including video ads they have to wait through to open the app. Several reviewers specifically call out popups asking them to rate 5 stars, which has the opposite effect on their willingness to rate. Even people who liked the product say the ads make them consider uninstalling. Distribution is mixed but skewed negative.

title: Photo editor turned into a forced social network, hurting basic editing flow
description: Long-time users complain that recent updates pushed the photo editor toward a social network model, forcing registration, making it easy to accidentally publish photos publicly, and adding extra steps before users can simply save an edited image. Several say they previously paid for content that has now been removed or hidden, and that simple flows like crop, filter, and save are now harder. About 73% of ratings are 1-2 stars, indicating significant regression for the loyal base.
affected_component: Photo editor save/share workflow / account requirements

title: Collage maker is widely loved, with strong creative variety
description: Reviewers strongly enjoy the collage maker, calling out the variety of frames, add-ons, easy-to-use flow, and how well it pairs with other editing apps. A few mention the experience improved after support helped them with feature confusion. With ~82% of ratings at 4-5 stars, this is overwhelmingly positive feedback rather than a defect cluster.

title: Video editing features and new effects are getting praise
description: Users are excited about the video editing capabilities of the app, including new effects, subtitle support, video cropping, and slideshow creation with background music. Most short reviews are simply calling it amazing or perfect for their use case. Some note inability to edit MOV files specifically. About 82% of ratings are 4-5 stars.

title: Frequent layout/UI changes are confusing long-time users
description: Users say the layout keeps being redesigned every few releases, and each change moves controls, removes labels, or scrambles the article ordering they had grown used to. Long-time users specifically dislike that articles are no longer listed newest-first and that familiar buttons are now unlabeled or relocated. Some are uninstalling because they can no longer find features they relied on. Ratings are mixed but skewed negative on the new layout.

title: Launcher's themes/wallpapers are popular, but app overrides user choices
description: Users like that the launcher offers a wide variety of themes, wallpapers, ringtones, and customization, and many call it lightweight and feature-rich. The main complaint is that it sometimes forces wallpapers or theme choices on the user instead of respecting their own pick, and a couple of users felt it was watching their device. Ratings skew positive (about 65% at 4-5 stars) so this is a refinement cluster.

title: Photo editor is highly rated for ease of use across personal and small-business cases
description: Users describe the photo editor as easy, fun, and helpful for both personal photos and small-business graphics, with comments highlighting how quickly they can edit, combine, and share pictures. One user notes the absence of a red-eye removal tool as the only downside. With over 90% of ratings at 4-5 stars, this is a clearly positive cluster.

title: App crashes, hangs on white screen, or fails to load on specific Samsung/Xiaomi devices
description: Users on specific devices, especially Samsung Galaxy S6/S7/S7 Edge, S4, and Xiaomi Redmi 3S, report that the app either hangs on a blank white screen on launch, fails to load downloaded maps past a certain percent, or doesn't display notifications until brought to the foreground. Some are also unable to uninstall the app from their device administrator settings. About 70% of ratings are 1-2 stars and the issue is clearly device-specific.

title: Camera/photo features broken on Samsung Galaxy S4/S5/S7 after updates
description: Users on Samsung Galaxy S4 mini, S5, S7, S7 Active, and Galaxy Pro tablets say recent updates broke camera-related and photo-edit features: aspect ratios reset, taking a picture restarts the phone, the draw module is no longer reachable from the editor, dash-cam recording does not work, and brightness behavior changed after a Marshmallow update. Several would re-rate higher if the device-specific issue were fixed. Ratings skew 1-3 star, with 1-star the largest single bucket.
affected_component: Camera / editor compatibility on Samsung devices

title: AppLock and fingerprint lock not working on Samsung Galaxy S4/S5/S6/A5/S8
description: Users on Samsung Galaxy S4, S5, S6, A5, and S8 report that AppLock either reports the device as incompatible, fails to lock incoming calls, or stops recognizing the fingerprint after a software/firmware update. Several have re-enrolled their fingerprints with no effect, and want a fix or compatibility update. Sample is small but ratings are dominated by 1-stars (60%) with no 4-5 star reviews, indicating a hard incompatibility.
affected_component: AppLock / fingerprint authentication on Samsung devices

title: Cannot sign in on Samsung Galaxy S5/S7/S7 Edge/Tab — persistent 'internal error'
description: Users on Samsung Galaxy S5, S7, S7 Edge, and Galaxy Tab cannot sign in to the app, repeatedly getting an 'internal error, please restart the app' message. They have already tried uninstalling and reinstalling, clearing cache and data, and even factory resetting, with no effect. The same accounts work on older Galaxy devices, and one user notes the issue stems from the app not setting required permissions automatically and requiring manual permission grants. The cluster is small but 80% of ratings are 1-star, and login is fully blocked, which prevents core use of the app.
affected_component: Sign-in flow on Samsung Galaxy devices
